component.name: Stagno
component.summary: The browser for DuckNet, the playful alternative to HTTP

description.p: Stagno opens duck:// addresses. It asks the DuckNet DNS where a name lives and talks DUCK/1, DuckNet's own protocol, through the DuckNet relay: there is no HTTP underneath.

ul.li: Tabs, a light and a dark theme, in English, Italian and Russian
Only DuckNet: regular http and https pages are never opened, and neither are resources a duck page tries to load from the web

description.p: Stagno can update itself: check from the menu, or automatically once a day if you allow it.
Fixes: a host that could silently stop answering, and a cleaner exit.
Installable packages: a .deb for Debian and Ubuntu and a Windows setup wizard.
First version of the Stagno browser.
First version of DuckNet: the DUCK/1 protocol, DNS server, relay and host.
